_comment: UNSEEN validation set. Written after all detection rules/behavioral signals/thresholds were finalized, specifically to test generalization -- none of this wording was used to write packages/domain/risk/behavioral_signals.py's regex patterns, packages/domain/risk/detector.py's RISK_SIGNALS keywords, or any test in tests/unit/test_scam_regression.py or tests/unit/test_char_detection.py. Deliberately avoids the canonical phrasing those use ('reply with the verification code', 'temporary authentication value', 'OTP', 'MFA code') wherever the category allows, including several 'subtle' MFA/credential examples that never say OTP/password/MFA/verification/token at all -- these are expected to be the hardest cases for a regex-based detector and a drop in recall on them is an honest, expected finding, not a bug. See docs/ml/phase8-evaluation.md's 'Update' section for how this set relates to the development and regression data.
